pushKeys.title: Push notification keys (VAPID)
pushKeys.configured: Push keys are set on the server ✓ — notifications work.
pushKeys.notConfigured: Push keys aren't set yet. Create them here, then add them in Vercel.
pushKeys.intro: The keys are created inside your browser only. The private key is never sent to a server or saved. Copy it straight into Vercel's settings.
pushKeys.privateWarning: The private key is secret: never paste it into a chat or email. Put it only into Vercel. If you close this page before copying, just create new keys.
pushKeys.step1: Open Vercel → your project → Settings → Environment Variables.
pushKeys.step2: Add the three variables (name on the left, value on the right). For VAPID_SUBJECT use your email as mailto:.
pushKeys.step3: Click Save, then Deployments → latest → ⋯ → Redeploy.
pushKeys.step4: After the redeploy, every doctor and staff member opens "My account" and taps "Turn on". (Changing the keys later disconnects registered devices.)

site.concept: Concept website for this demo — not the clinic's official site. Doctors and times are demo data.

site.how1Text: We send a code by WhatsApp or SMS. No account, no password.
site.how2Text: Treatment, branch, doctor (or any), and a free time.
site.how3Text: Confirmation and a reminder on WhatsApp; change or cancel from your link.
site.treatmentsText: Prices are starting prices; your doctor confirms the plan at the visit.

site.videoText: For follow-ups, results and first opinions. A private link on WhatsApp, nothing to install, never recorded.
site.videoPoint3: Same doctors as in the clinic
site.doctorsText: Choose your doctor when you book, or the first one free.
site.faq1q: Do I need an account to book?
site.faq1a: No. You verify your mobile number with a one-time code, then choose your visit. The code proves the booking is yours.
site.faq2q: How do I change or cancel?
site.faq2a: From the link in your WhatsApp confirmation or on “My appointments”. Free up to {hours} hours before the visit.
site.faq3q: Can I choose a female doctor?
site.faq3a: Yes. On the booking page choose a doctor by name, or “any female doctor”.
site.faq4a: Yes. The link is personal and signed, the call is never recorded, and you sign a telehealth consent first.
site.faq5a: Your file is visible only to your clinic's staff, and clinical notes only to your doctors.
site.finalText: Pick a time that suits you — it takes about a minute.
site.metaDescription: {name}: dermatology and aesthetics. Book online in a minute or see a doctor by video.
